first_entry.name: First Light

first_checkin.name: Cleared for Launch
first_checkin.description: Complete a mission objective for the first time.

streak_3.name: Stable Orbit
streak_3.description: Hold an orbit streak on any objective for 3 days.
streak_3.unlock: Three days in orbit. Trajectory stable.

streak_7.name: Weekly Orbiter
streak_7.description: Hold an orbit streak on any objective for 7 days.
streak_7.unlock: Seven days in orbit. Systems nominal, Captain.

streak_14.name: Lunar Flyby
streak_14.description: Hold an orbit streak on any objective for 14 days.
streak_14.unlock: Fourteen days out. Lunar flyby confirmed.

streak_30.name: Deep Space Voyager
streak_30.description: Hold an orbit streak on any objective for 30 days.
streak_30.unlock: Thirty days in the dark and holding steady. Voyager status granted.

streak_60.name: Beyond the Belt
streak_60.description: Hold an orbit streak on any objective for 60 days.
streak_60.unlock: Sixty days out. The asteroid belt is far behind you, Captain.

streak_100.name: Interstellar Navigator
streak_100.description: Hold an orbit streak on any objective for 100 days.
streak_100.unlock: One hundred days. You are beyond the charts now, Captain.

entries_7.name: Log Keeper
entries_7.description: Record a log entry on 7 different days.
entries_7.unlock: Seven days logged. The ship's record grows.

entries_30.name: Chief Chronicler
entries_30.description: Record a log entry on 30 different days.
entries_30.unlock: Thirty days on record. Mission control is impressed.

entries_100.name: Fleet Archivist
entries_100.description: Record a log entry on 100 different days.
entries_100.unlock: One hundred logs on file. Your voyage is beautifully documented.

prompts_10.name: Signal Decoded
prompts_10.unlock: Ten transmissions answered. Receiving you loud and clear.

prompts_50.name: Comms Commander
prompts_50.unlock: Fifty transmissions answered. The channel is wide open.

habits_3.name: Triple Orbit

habits_3.unlock: Three orbits, one captain. Flawless formation.
